description: OneUp Today finds people on Reddit who are already describing the problem your product solves, and turns them into a reviewable outreach pipeline. With this plugin you can review the campaigns running in your OneUp account, browse the leads each one discovered with their relevance scores and funnel status, read the conversation history with any lead, and draft a personalized opener using OneUp's message writer. Approved drafts can be queued for delivery, and you can check send readiness before you do. Every message is delivered through your own connected browser session, so outreach always goes out as you, on your own account, after you have approved it. Drafting and sending are always separate steps: nothing is sent without an explicit confirmation. New here? Sign in with Google on first use; the account is created for you and the first Reddit lead search starts from this chat: say what your product's website is. Requires a OneUp Today account.

defaultPrompt: Find people on Reddit who need my product
Is my Reddit outreach ready to send right now?
